text: The title screen shows load progress, then Start, Continue, New pilot or Join friends, and keeps the pilot name and drone color.
At least 30 stat-driven achievements unlock exactly once, announce themselves and show progress in the pilot log.
A waypoint shows an on-screen marker with distance, an edge arrow when off-screen, a compass pip, and clears on arrival.
Unlocking a card plays a reveal that can open the card in the collection book.
Crash and splash flashes, speed lines and the FPS counter respond to flight and settings.
Nothing happens behind the title or an open panel: the sim waits for Start, the HUD cannot be reached under the title, and wind does not carry the drone away while a panel is open.

The tutorial has at most five steps (fly, turn, climb and descend in either order, boost, follow the objective), each completes from real key presses or touches on the free-running game, and it ends with a waypoint on the first open Founder Trail stop.
